_comment: SDXL masked object-replacement workflow (ComfyUI API format). The graph STRUCTURE lives here; backend/comfy_replace.py injects per-request VALUES by node id (never rebuilds the graph). Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the init image (original crop with the replacement composited into the object's footprint) -> restrict denoising to the object mask (SetLatentNoiseMask) -> KSampler harmonises only the masked region into the scene's lighting/perspective/shadows -> decode -> save. Everything outside the mask is reconstructed from the original latent, so surrounding pixels are preserved.

inputs.text: blurry, lowres, distorted, deformed, artifacts, seam, extra objects, watermark, text
